customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in the market, with excellent installation and premium appearance. The water quality receives positive feedback, with customers noting it makes a noticeable difference and is very pure. While some customers consider it worth the price, others warn not to waste money on it. reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.body: The entire experience from fast delivery to installation was completely seamless. The technician was extremely knowledgeable and explained all the features and maintenance thoroughly. Getting the TDS meter was a great touch—it made verifying the water quality and taste improvement immediate. The purifier works quietly, looks great, and delivers excellent performance. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: A Flawed Product I recently purchased a Crompton water heater, and within 20 days, I've encountered a terrifying issue. The water connection pipes are inexplicably live, carrying an electric current. This is an extremely dangerous situation that could lead to severe injury or even death. When I contacted Crompton's technical support, their response was utterly shocking. They claimed that this was "working as expected." Such a dismissive and irresponsible attitude is unacceptable, especially given the potential risks involved. I strongly advise against purchasing any Crompton products. Their disregard for customer safety is evident in this incident.
reviews.title: Excellent Product – Native M1 Pro Water Purifier
reviews.body: I am very happy with the Native M1 Pro water purifier. The product has a sleek, modern design and delivers excellent water purification. The water tastes clean and refreshing, and the purifier is easy to use and maintain. The build quality is impressive, and it offers great value for money. Overall, a great choice for anyone looking for a reliable, efficient, and stylish water purifier for their home. Highly recommended!
